title: CANADA VIGNETTES: LOG DRIVER'S WALTZ | Full Animated Film | National Film Board of Canada
summary: An animated National Film Board of Canada short about a young woman who picks a log driver as her partner because his work makes him a great dancer. It is set to Wade Hemsworth's folk song sung by Kate and Anna McGarrigle.
why: It comes up as a beloved example of NFB animation and state-funded Canadian cultural work.

quote.text: Wade Hemsworth was a national treasure. So many great folk songs.
